name: screen-viewer
description: Responsive screen viewer for testing apps at multiple resolutions

scripts.publish: rm -rf dist && electron-builder --mac dmg zip && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && gh release create v$VERSION dist/Screen-Viewer-$VERSION-arm64.dmg dist/Screen-Viewer-$VERSION-arm64.dmg.blockmap dist/Screen-Viewer-$VERSION-arm64-mac.zip dist/Screen-Viewer-$VERSION-arm64-mac.zip.blockmap dist/latest-mac.yml --title "v$VERSION" --repo trmp10/screen-viewer
